_comment: DEV-ONLY overrides for a standalone `dotnet run` (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development). Docker does NOT use this file for secrets — it reads everything from .env. Every value here is a throwaway local default and must never be reused in production.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Point at a local Postgres + Redis started via `docker compose up db redis`. Passwords match the dev defaults in .env.example.

MyPassKeys._comment_Bootstrap: Management-tenant identity seeded on first startup of a standalone `dotnet run` (Kestrel :5205). The Docker path uses the BOOTSTRAP_MANAGEMENT_* variables in .env instead. Seed-only — change later via PUT /tenants/{id}.
MyPassKeys._comment_KeyEncryptionKey: DEV-ONLY key-encryption key for signing keys at rest, so `dotnet run` works out of the box. Production supplies its own via MyPassKeys__KeyEncryptionKey (KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the server's .env) — never reuse this value outside local development.
